Frank Review: The Slow-But-Deadly Undead Razer
Frank is a 4-star Epic Ice hero from the
family, originally released during the Halloween event of 2020. Modeled after the classic Frankenstein's monster, Frank is a
mana speed tank-buster who specializes in wide-range destruction. While his speed and aging stats hold him back in standard play, he remains a cult classic for
tournaments and wars, where he transforms from a lumbering brute into a devastating wrecking ball. This review focuses on his base form, though we will touch on his costume for comparison.

Frank’s design is a delightful nod to the classic movie monster, complete with green skin, bolts in the neck, and a less-than-tailored suit. He looks like he’s trying his best to fit in at a formal dinner but might accidentally crush the silverware. It’s a charmingly "ugly" design that fits perfectly with the spooky yet slightly goofy vibe of the Return to Morlovia event. Compared to his mobster-themed costume, the base version feels more iconic and true to the source material.
